info.title: SRM Gateway APIs V1
info.description:
### Welcome to the Decisiv SRM Gateway APIs documentation. 
 Our APIs allow for creating and managing cases in the Decisiv platform. The SRM APIs are divided into modules, which support case creation and asset management from both the Service Providers and Fleet perspectives. 
 The APIs are built to provide the same functionality currently available in the core Decisiv SRM Platform application and to help customers facilitate commercial asset management. 

------

 ### To learn more about the solutions please visit our [Solutions Center](https://www.decisivmarketplace.com/solutions-center/) on the [Decisiv Marketplace](https://decisivmarketplace.com/)
 -   For Service Providers, learn more by clicking  [here](https://www.decisivmarketplace.com/product/srm-gateway-for-service-providers/).
-  For Fleets and Asset Managers, learn more by clicking  [here](https://www.decisivmarketplace.com/product/srm-gateway-for-fleets-and-asset-managers/).
-    For Partners, learn more by clicking  [here](https://www.decisivmarketplace.com/product/srm-gateway-for-partners/).

--------
